description: Defines the interface and data structures for the Starboard Accessibility module, providing access to system accessibility settings such as text-to-speech, display contrast, and closed captioning.

methods.name: GetTextToSpeechSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current text-to-speech accessibility settings from the platform.

methods.name: GetDisplaySettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current high contrast display settings from the platform.

methods.name: GetCaptionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current closed captioning settings from the platform.

methods.name: SetCaptionsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables closed captions at the system level.
